sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up single man against a continuous mottled gray-brown studio background, dark around the upper corners and lighter toward the lower-left; no photograph card, frame, note, or cutout silhouette. Dark brown swept-back side-parted hair with a raised front wave and gray at the temples, dark brows, visibly clean upper lip and chin, no hat. A single round gold-rimmed monocle covers the screen-right eye, with a thin gold chain curving down across the screen-right cheek toward the ear/side of the head; keep this single lens and its chain rather than paired spectacles. Head and chest are slightly angled toward screen-left while the eyes look toward the viewer, with a closed neutral serious mouth. Dark charcoal V-neck knitted vest over a light cream-gray pointed-collar shirt and a small dark blue-gray necktie; the light collar lies over the vest opening. Preserve the broad shoulders, chest crop, subdued colors, upper-left face highlights and opposite cheek shadow. Exact source is156x210 with measured alpha252..255 across the painted rectangle; preserve the complete painted backing without adding exterior transparency. Tiny stitch details are not resolved by these pixels.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up single man against a continuous dark olive-gray upper background fading to lighter gray lower down, with no card, frame, paper note, or exterior cutout. Short dark brown hair combed back with gray side hair and a slightly wavy top, dark brows, a large gray-brown curled moustache and a full thick salt-and-pepper beard covering chin and jaw. No eyewear or hat. A dark brown bent smoking pipe is held at the screen-left corner of the mouth: the slim stem extends down-left and meets an upward-facing thick bowl toward screen-left. Retain the pipe shape and its position independently of the moustache. Near-frontal head slightly turned toward screen-left, eyes directed toward the viewer, mouth occupied by the pipe with a restrained serious expression. Dark brown plaid jacket or outer shirt with broad lapels over a pale cream open-neck collared shirt; a dark V-shaped opening shows between the open collar points, without a tie. Preserve both the check pattern and the folded pale collar, shoulder crop, soft upper-left highlights and right-side shadows. Exact156x210 painted source has alpha252..255; retain the complete background and all dark clothing, with no new transparency. Tiny cloth and beard strands remain limited by the source resolution.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up single man on a continuous shaded gray/olive studio backdrop, darker at top and lighter at lower-left; there is no photograph frame, card, overlapping note or cutout silhouette. Taupe-gray fedora with a broad dark brown band and wide brim, its crown tilted and lit on the upper-right surface. Short dark hair with some gray is visible under the hat at the sides. Dark round-lensed spectacles with two separate circular rims and a visible bridge cover the eyes; keep their dark tint and both lenses. Dark brows, visibly smooth upper lip and chin, no moustache or beard. Face turned slightly toward screen-right, lips closed with a neutral reserved expression. Light taupe suit jacket with broad notched lapels over a pale ivory pointed-collar shirt and a straight dark brown necktie. Preserve the hat width and angle, original shirt/tie arrangement, chest/shoulder crop, brim shadow over the eyes and warm face highlights. The exact156x210 source is a full painted rectangle with measured alpha252..255; keep its backing intact, with no added card or exterior transparency. Fine lens/hat texture cannot be specified beyond the visible pixels.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up single man against continuous muted olive-gray painted background with dark upper corners and lighter gray beside the shoulders; no frame, card, note or exterior cutout. Dark brown hair swept back in soft waves with a side part, dark brows, clean upper lip and clean chin, no hat or eyewear. Head is angled slightly toward screen-right with eyes looking toward the viewer and a closed restrained mouth. A short narrow tan-brown smoking object projects down-right from the screen-right corner of the mouth and has a thicker dark reddish end; preserve that exact small visible stem/tip silhouette. Thin pale smoke curls upward alongside the screen-right cheek and eye into the upper-right background. The small object cannot be securely classified more finely from these pixels, so do not invent a long pipe, hand or different prop. Dark navy broad-notched-lapel jacket over a blue-gray buttoned pointed-collar shirt, buttoned to the neck, with visible pale shirt buttons and no tie. Preserve chest crop, shoulder position, original smoke, shirt collar/button arrangement and upper-left face lighting. Exact156x210 painted source has alpha252..255; retain the complete painted backing and dark garments without adding transparent space.
